author: ReyCassie
body:
Dear Avicus staff team,

i just got got temp banned for combat logging for 3 days when I didn't even combat log. I died and I left the game straight away to check out the other rotations of the other servers as few has changed. I really don't get why I have been temp banned when I didn't even combat log

If there is a way to prove it I'll prove it that I didn't combat log

from nemo
